entities.summary: Daniel Edward Thomas is an American prelate of the Catholic Church who has been bishop of the Diocese of Toledo in America in the state of Ohio since 2014. He is the chairman of the Pro-Life Activities Committee of the U.S. Conference of Catholic Bishops. He was an auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of Philadelphia in Pennsylvania from 2006 to 2014.
